scripts.bundle: REDOCLY_SUPPRESS_UPDATE_NOTICE=true redocly bundle spec/openapi.yaml -o dist/openapi.yaml && REDOCLY_SUPPRESS_UPDATE_NOTICE=true redocly bundle spec/relay-mailbox.yaml -o dist/relay-mailbox.yaml && uv run scripts/finalize_bundle.py dist/openapi.yaml dist/relay-mailbox.yaml
scripts.lint: npm run -s bundle && spectral lint --fail-severity=warn dist/openapi.yaml dist/relay-mailbox.yaml spec/asyncapi.yaml
scripts.mock:static: npm run -s bundle && prism mock -h 127.0.0.1 -p 4011 dist/openapi.yaml
